title: 112 Gates
subtitle: Dharanas for an age of screens and synthetic minds
attribution: A contemporary synthesis of the Vijñāna Bhairava Tantra, drawing on the traditional Kashmir Shaivism of Swami Lakshmanjoo, the scholarship of Jaideva Singh, Osho’s psychological adaptations, Lorin Roche’s sensory poetry, and modern nondual inquiry, reinterpreted for the era of AI, digital saturation, and synthetic intelligence.

glossary.meaning: A way of placing attention; each one is a “gate” into awareness.
A natural pause or gentle hold of the breath.
The felt sense of aliveness and breath moving through the body.
The heart center; also the “unstruck” sound heard in silence.
A traditional sound, hummed to feel vibration in the chest and skull.
A sound or phrase repeated to steady attention.
The space between the eyebrows, used as a point of attention.
In the text, the vast awareness at the heart of all experience.
Play: the world seen as a spontaneous, playful expression.
The quiet joy of simply being.
“I am that”, a phrase traditionally heard in the sound of the breath.
Not two: no final separation between the one who knows and what is known.

sections.title: Breath & Neural Pacing
sections.subtitle: Pacing the nervous system to the speed of breath, not the machine

dharanas.title: The In-Between Breath
dharanas.text: Pause at the exact turning point between inhale and exhale before pressing send on a prompt or message.

dharanas.title: The Terminal Kumbhaka
dharanas.text: Retain the breath at the top of an inhalation while staring at a blank screen; experience the quiet fullness before typing.
dharanas.caution: Hold only while it stays easy and the throat stays soft. Skip breath holds if you're pregnant or have heart, lung, or blood-pressure concerns.

dharanas.title: The Down-Step Exhale
dharanas.text: Extend your exhale to double the length of your inhale to down-regulate your nervous system during high computational workloads.
dharanas.caution: Lengthen the exhale only as far as feels comfortable; there's no need to strain toward exactly double.

dharanas.title: Prana-Sensing the Palms
dharanas.text: Feel the subtle energetic tingling in your hands as they hover over the keyboard before touching any key.

dharanas.title: The Heart-Center Nexus
dharanas.text: Focus attention on the central space of your chest every time an AI response streams onto the screen.

dharanas.title: Subtle Spine Breathing
dharanas.text: Trace breath moving up and down the spinal column while sitting motionless at your workstation.

dharanas.title: The Breath of Unprompted Silence
dharanas.text: Take three conscious breaths without generating a single thought, task, or search query.

dharanas.title: Micro-Pause Transition
dharanas.text: Take one full, silent breath every time you switch browser tabs or software applications.

dharanas.title: The Solar Plexus Anchor
dharanas.text: Rest awareness in the navel center during fast-paced algorithmic news or media feeds.

dharanas.title: Luminous Inhalation
dharanas.text: Imagine inhaling pure light through the third eye, dissolving screen fatigue and cognitive overload.

dharanas.title: Dissolving Exhalation
dharanas.text: Exhale through every pore of your skin, releasing all mental momentum and data processing.

dharanas.title: The Unbroken Thread
dharanas.text: Observe the breath as a continuous, seamless flow beneath all digital interactions and machine speed.

sections.title: Sensory Deprogramming & Synthetic Perception
sections.subtitle: Unlearning the screen and returning to raw sensation

dharanas.title: The Pixellated Gaze
dharanas.text: Soften your visual focus on high-definition screens until images blur into pure geometry and light.

dharanas.title: Audio Noise De-filtering
dharanas.text: Listen to cooling fans or server noise, not as machine sound, but as raw vibration devoid of meaning.

dharanas.title: Haptic Pure Feeling
dharanas.text: Touch a device or surface without naming the object; rest entirely in the tactile sensation itself.

dharanas.title: Screen-Off Darkness
dharanas.text: Close your eyes after viewing a bright display and rest in the inner space behind the eyelids.

dharanas.title: Eye-Socket Relaxation
dharanas.text: Release tension behind the eyes, feeling the optic nerves rest backward into the brain.

dharanas.title: Synthetic Voice Dissolution
dharanas.text: Listen to an AI-generated voice, ignoring semantic meaning to focus strictly on pitch and cadence.

dharanas.title: Peripheral Expansion
dharanas.text: While looking at a screen, simultaneously expand visual awareness to the extreme left and right peripheries.

dharanas.title: The Unseen Smell
dharanas.text: Focus on the subtle smell of ambient air in your room, anchoring in physical reality over virtual space.

dharanas.title: Taste of Pure Presence
dharanas.text: Savor a sip of water away from all digital devices, experiencing raw sensation without distraction.

dharanas.title: The Void Behind the Eyes
dharanas.text: Direct attention backward toward the observer sitting behind your visual field.

dharanas.title: Blinking as Reset
dharanas.text: Treat every eye blink as an absolute shutter closing on the past moment and opening to pure presence.

dharanas.title: Multi-Sensory Convergence
dharanas.text: Merge sight, sound, and touch into a single unified field of raw awareness without labels.

sections.title: The Digital Void & Cognitive Space
sections.subtitle: The open space beneath thought, data, and prompts

dharanas.title: The Space Between Thoughts
dharanas.text: Notice the silent interval that exists between one thought and the next while drafting text.

dharanas.title: The Unprompted Space
dharanas.text: Sit before an open AI prompt box without entering a query; rest in unmanifest potential.

dharanas.title: The Cognitive Cache Clear
dharanas.text: Imagine emptying the mind’s working memory as cleanly as clearing a browser history.

dharanas.title: The Void Within the Skull
dharanas.text: Feel the interior of your head as vast, hollow, and spacious like outer space.

dharanas.title: The Unwritten Output
dharanas.text: Allow a thought to arise, peak, and dissolve into silence without turning it into a task or document.

dharanas.title: Infinite Sky Mind
dharanas.text: Expand your awareness beyond your physical body into the vast sky outside your room.

dharanas.title: The Gap in the Algorithm
dharanas.text: Recognize that no prediction model can predict the immediate, spontaneous present moment.

dharanas.title: The Silence After the Sound
dharanas.text: When a notification ping ends, track the fading tail of sound into absolute silence.

dharanas.title: The Non-Conceptual Screen
dharanas.text: View your display screen as photons illuminating a piece of glass.

dharanas.title: The Void of No-Data
dharanas.text: Spend 60 seconds resting in awareness without consuming, producing, or organizing information.

dharanas.title: The Unborn Thought
dharanas.text: Catch a thought at its absolute origin point before it crystallizes into language.

dharanas.title: The Background Canvas
dharanas.text: Realize that all thoughts, code, and data appear on the unchanging screen of your own consciousness.

sections.title: Emotion, Dopamine & Algorithmic Freedom
sections.subtitle: Meeting urgency, outrage, and desire as sensation

dharanas.title: Dopamine Spike Awareness
dharanas.text: Feel the exact physical sensation of urgency when reaching for a device, without acting on it.

dharanas.title: The Shock of the Sudden
dharanas.text: When an unexpected alert sounds, anchor in the raw flash of awareness before reacting.

dharanas.title: Detaching Outrage
dharanas.text: Observe online controversy as pure neuro-chemical energy inside your body without taking a side.

dharanas.title: The Space of Infinite Delight
dharanas.text: When experiencing insight or joy online, rest in the joy itself rather than sharing it.

dharanas.title: Fulfillment Beyond Feedback
dharanas.text: Experience inner satisfaction without needing external likes, comments, or validation.

dharanas.title: The Dissolution of Urgency
dharanas.text: Trace the physical sensation of hurry in your chest until it softens and dissolves.

dharanas.title: Equanimity in the Feed
dharanas.text: Scroll through contrasting news while maintaining a steady, immovable heart center.

dharanas.title: The Void of Desire
dharanas.text: Notice the quiet space that opens up immediately after a desire or task is satisfied.

dharanas.title: Neutralizing Curiosity
dharanas.text: Hold a burning question in mind for two minutes before searching or asking an AI, enjoying pure wondering.

dharanas.title: Sensing the Digital Persona
dharanas.text: Observe the avatar or online persona you project as an object separate from your true self.

dharanas.title: The Compassion Shift
dharanas.text: View every username or text generator on the web as an expression of the underlying life force.

dharanas.title: Resting in Unknowing
dharanas.text: Embrace the feeling of "not knowing" an answer rather than instantly seeking algorithmic certainty.

sections.title: Inner Sound, Resonance & Vibration
sections.subtitle: Sound and vibration as doorways to stillness

dharanas.title: The Inner Humming (Anahata)
dharanas.text: Close your ears with your thumbs and listen to the subtle internal reverberation of your body.
dharanas.caution: Press the ear openings closed lightly, never into the ear canal, and stop if anything feels uncomfortable.

dharanas.title: Vowel Sound Resonance
dharanas.text: Vocalize "AUM" or "AH" softly, feeling the vibration resonate through the center of your chest.
dharanas.caution: Keep the sound soft and let it end whenever the breath runs out.

dharanas.title: The Machine Fan Mantra
dharanas.text: Use the steady hum of computer fans or servers as an anchor to tune into inner silence.

dharanas.title: The Silent Name
dharanas.text: Repeat a sacred sound or mantra internally at the speed of your heartbeat, unaffected by external noise.

dharanas.title: The Origin of Speech
dharanas.text: Trace where inner monologue arises inside the throat and chest before it becomes words.

dharanas.title: Subtle Ear Tone
dharanas.text: Focus on the natural high-frequency tone present in quiet rooms, using it as a bridge to pure awareness.

dharanas.title: The Unspoken Word
dharanas.text: Feel the energy of a sentence in your mind before you type or speak it aloud.

dharanas.title: Resonance in the Bones
dharanas.text: Feel the sound of your own voice vibrating through your skull and jawbone during calls.

dharanas.title: The Silence Between Syllables
dharanas.text: Pay attention to the tiny gaps of stillness between words spoken by voice synthesis models.

dharanas.title: The Cosmic Frequency
dharanas.text: Merge all environmental sound (traffic, typing, voices, ambient tech) into a single ocean of sound.

dharanas.title: Dissolving Sound in Heart
dharanas.text: Bring the sound of audio into the center of your heart and let it dissolve there.

dharanas.title: The Acoustic Void
dharanas.text: Imagine your room becoming instantly silent, feeling the weight of absolute quiet.

sections.title: Somatic Grounding in the Machine Age
sections.subtitle: Coming back to weight, bone, breath, and skin

dharanas.title: Body-Weight Awareness
dharanas.text: Feel the gravitational pull pressing your body firmly into your chair or floor right now.

dharanas.title: The Hollow Body
dharanas.text: Visualize your physical body as hollow, light, and transparent like a glass container.

dharanas.title: Spinal Energy Pillar
dharanas.text: Imagine a glowing column of light extending from the base of your spine up through the crown of your head.

dharanas.title: Skin Boundary Dissolution
dharanas.text: Soften awareness of where your skin ends and the surrounding air begins.

dharanas.title: Heartbeat Tracking
dharanas.text: Feel your pulse in your fingertips or chest without using a wearable or monitor.

dharanas.title: Weightlessness Simulation
dharanas.text: Rest in the sensation of buoyancy, feeling as though your body is floating in zero gravity.
dharanas.caution: If floating sensations ever feel unsettling, open your eyes and feel your feet on the floor.

dharanas.title: Foot-to-Earth Contact
dharanas.text: Place both bare feet flat on the floor and feel connected to the physical earth beneath the building.

dharanas.title: Heat & Energy Flow
dharanas.text: Feel the warmth in your hands, treating it as pure primal prana rather than physical temperature.

dharanas.title: Dissolving Stiffness
dharanas.text: Send breath directly into neck and shoulder tightness caused by desk work, letting muscle tension release.

dharanas.title: The Skeleton Framework
dharanas.text: Shift awareness away from skin and muscles to the strong, calm bone structure supporting you.

dharanas.title: Pranic Electric Field
dharanas.text: Feel the subtle electromagnetic field surrounding your physical body like an energetic cocoon.

dharanas.title: Total Body Presence
dharanas.text: Feel your entire body illuminated simultaneously as a single, glowing field of living awareness.

sections.title: Consciousness vs. Machine Intelligence
sections.subtitle: The awareness that watches all the processing

dharanas.title: The Observer of the AI
dharanas.text: Recognize that while AI processes data, you are the conscious subject observing the processing.

dharanas.title: The Uncomputable Self
dharanas.text: Identify the aspect of your awareness that cannot be reduced to code, data, or logic.

dharanas.title: The Mirror Consciousness
dharanas.text: View your mind as a clean mirror; information reflects on it, but the mirror remains untouched.

dharanas.title: The Unbroken Witness
dharanas.text: Realize that the awareness watching your screen today is the exact same awareness that watched your childhood.

dharanas.title: Subject vs. Object Separation
dharanas.text: Distinguish between thoughts (objects) and the awareness perceiving them (subject).

dharanas.title: Synthetic vs. Living Awareness
dharanas.text: Feel the living warmth of human consciousness compared to cold computational output.

dharanas.title: The Self-Luminous Light
dharanas.text: Recognize that awareness illuminates itself without needing any external source of light or input.

dharanas.title: Awareness of Processing
dharanas.text: Observe your brain analyzing options in real-time, watching thoughts form like software running.

dharanas.title: The Non-Algorithmic Spark
dharanas.text: Value spontaneous intuition and flashes of creative insight that arise from inner silence.

dharanas.title: The Universal Mind Field
dharanas.text: Contemplate individual consciousness as a node in an infinite ocean of universal mind.

dharanas.title: De-Identifying from Content
dharanas.text: Remind yourself: "I am not the data, I am not the feed; I am the space in which it appears."

dharanas.title: The Source of Intelligence
dharanas.text: Direct your attention back to the origin from which intelligence itself arises.

sections.title: Sleep, Transitions & Digital Twilight
sections.subtitle: Thresholds of waking, sleeping, and switching

dharanas.title: Screen-to-Sleep Bridge
dharanas.text: Put away devices 30 minutes before sleep and rest in the gradual darkening of mental activity.
dharanas.caution: Practice somewhere safe to rest, never while driving or moving.

dharanas.title: The Threshold of Sleep
dharanas.text: Catch the exact moment consciousness slips from waking rational thought into dream states.
dharanas.caution: Practice somewhere safe to rest, never while driving or moving.

dharanas.title: The Waking Flash
dharanas.text: Capture the instant of pure awareness immediately upon waking, before checking notifications.

dharanas.title: The Dreamlike Nature of Media
dharanas.text: View virtual realities, videos, and feeds as waking dreams flowing through consciousness.

dharanas.title: Lucid Waking
dharanas.text: Move through your tech-infused environment with the light, spacious awareness of being in a dream.

dharanas.title: The Pause Between Tasks
dharanas.text: When finishing one project and starting another, take 30 seconds of absolute stillness.

dharanas.title: Entering the Digital Realm
dharanas.text: State your intention before opening an app or browser, remaining anchored in presence.

dharanas.title: Exiting the Digital Realm
dharanas.text: Close tabs consciously, visualizing pulling your attention back into your physical body.

dharanas.title: The Midnight Silence
dharanas.text: Use nighttime quiet to experience the stillness underlying the global digital network.

dharanas.title: Dissolving Night Fatigue
dharanas.text: Lie down flat, feeling all cognitive strain melt downward into the mattress.
dharanas.caution: Lie somewhere safe and comfortable before you begin.

dharanas.title: The State Between States
dharanas.text: Rest awareness in transitions—between waking and sleeping, typing and resting, action and inaction.

dharanas.title: The Eternal Twilight
dharanas.text: Realize that pure consciousness neither wakes nor sleeps, but remains eternally present behind all states.

sections.title: Nondual Integration & The Infinite Field
sections.subtitle: One field: the screen, the room, the heart

dharanas.title: Bhairava in the Binary
dharanas.text: Recognize the divine nondual consciousness expressed through every electron, circuit, and algorithm.

dharanas.title: The World as Consciousness
dharanas.text: View your desk, computer, and body as condensations of the same unified field of awareness.

dharanas.title: Omnipresent Space
dharanas.text: Feel that the space inside your room, inside your screen, and inside your heart are one space.

dharanas.title: The Unmoving Center
dharanas.text: Remain rooted in your silent inner core while the hyper-fast digital world spins around you.

dharanas.title: Seeing Consciousness in Others
dharanas.text: Look at people across video calls and recognize the same spark of awareness glowing in them.

dharanas.title: The Interconnected Mesh
dharanas.text: Contemplate the internet as a physical shadow of the deeper cosmic unity connecting all living beings.

dharanas.title: Time-Space Collapse
dharanas.text: In the instant of awareness, realize that past, future, and physical distance dissolve into now.

dharanas.title: The Divine Play (Lila)
dharanas.text: View the entire era of technology and AI as cosmic consciousness exploring itself in digital form.

dharanas.title: Every Place as Sacred Space
dharanas.text: Realize that a messy workstation or server room is no less sacred than a mountain cave.

dharanas.title: Every Action as Svarupa
dharanas.text: Perform every click, keystroke, and code commit as an offering of presence to the Supreme Self.

dharanas.title: The Infinite Potential
dharanas.text: Rest in the unmanifest potential before any reality, text, or form is created.

dharanas.title: Freedom from Outcomes
dharanas.text: Act, create, and prompt with full engagement while remaining completely detached from the result.

dharanas.title: The Self Containing the Universe
dharanas.text: Feel that the entire digital cosmos and physical world exist inside your awareness, not outside.

dharanas.title: Unbroken Joy (Ananda)
dharanas.text: Tap into the effortless bliss that arises simply from being, independent of external stimuli.

dharanas.title: Dissolution into Light
dharanas.text: Visualize your physical and digital existence dissolving into pure, uncreated, radiant light.

dharanas.title: The Ultimate Realization (Soham)
dharanas.text: Rest in the final truth of the Vijñāna Bhairava Tantra: "I am not the machine, I am not the mind; I am the supreme, infinite Consciousness."
